note: Picks from the audition page (npm run audition). tools/build-audio.js builds from these. First set chosen by measurements (2026-10-11); change any by ear.

ui_click.note: 65 ms, instant attack, almost no low end: a soft, short button click

ui_toggle.note: a real switch flick, 90 ms, fast attack; pitched up/down for on/off

ui_confirm.note: a rounder pop (54% low-mids) with a 5 ms attack: fuller than the click, still short

spin_start.note: a metal lever pull: 70 ms attack, 55% mids / 16% lows, trimmed to 380 ms; air push from the refill whoosh under it

reel_stop.note: a damped thud: 5 ms attack, 82% low energy, 135 ms: solid, no ring

tick.note: a quick clack: instant, 75 ms, only 9% lows: barely there

refill.note: a soft whoosh: 45 ms rise, mostly mids, 415 ms; brightened per chain step by the engine

win_light.note: a bright shimmer: 5 ms attack, 53% highs, 1.3 s glittering tail

explode.note: a shattering chandelier: crystal, 15 ms attack, wide (0.48), 1.2 s scatter of glass

win_tick.note: one coin clink: instant, 170 ms, mid-focused; pitch rises with the count

win_land.note: coins collected: 60 ms attack, 345 ms, 69% highs: a short settling of coins

combine_total.note: a cash-register ching: 35 ms attack, bright: the total locking in

strike.note: an electric zap: 5 ms attack, 71% highs: the crack on the flash

thunder.note: a one-shot thunderclap: 5 ms attack, wide (0.59), 49% lows: the short tail under the crack

bang.note: an anvil hit: instant metal strike (lead-in trimmed), bright; weight scaled by value in the engine

soul_launch.note: a fast swing whoosh: 55 ms rise, 230 ms, wide: things flying off the board

catch.note: a mechanical key: 5 ms attack, 200 ms, 55% highs: a metallic lock-in click

combine_slam.note: a hard glass impact: instant, 58% lows, 420 ms: the chips colliding

scatter.note: a pure ping: instant attack, 1.7 s clean ring, 70% mids: a tuned bell that steps up per scatter

riser.note: a slow riser: 8 s of rise, 62% mids: the tension bed (looped while one scatter away)

scatter_catch.note: a real gong: 55 ms attack, 5 s bloom: the biggest non-win hit

vault_slam.note: a fire door closing: 60 ms attack, 49% lows, 625 ms: a heavy door slam

feature_award.note: trumpet fanfare: 35 ms attack, 74% mids, 3 s: short brass fanfare

feature_more.note: horn stabs: 15 ms attack, 1.3 s: a lighter brass cousin of the fanfare

fs_intro.note: a movie swell: 700 ms rise, wide (0.67), 67% lows: cinematic lift into the bonus

fs_outro.note: a win fantasia sting: 15 ms attack, 2.6 s resolve: a closing flourish

bigwin_open.note: a hit and whoosh: 5 ms attack, wide (0.72), 1.5 s: the overlay bursting open

sub_impact.note: a deep boom: 35 ms attack, 95% lows, 1.5 s: the sub under the big moments

win_big.note: cinematic hit with horns: 50 ms attack, 77% lows, wide (0.63), 3.3 s

win_mega.note: a horn victory hit: 10 ms attack, wide (0.70), 2.3 s: bigger and brighter than Big

choir.note: a short choir: 80 ms attack, 80% mids, 1.9 s: the voices on Epic and Max

max_win.note: a dramatic hit: 85 ms attack, 88% lows, 3.9 s decay: the floor of the biggest moment

buy.note: a chest full of coins: 60 ms attack, bright, wide (0.52): coins handed over

reverb_ir.note: a church impulse: 1.3 s decay, mid-focused: one shared space, sent lightly
